Education
Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT), Pune Pune, India
Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology; CGPA: 8.85/10 2024 – 2028 (Expected)
– Relevant Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, DBMS, Distributed
Systems Fundamentals, OOP.
Technical Skills
Languages: Go, Python,C, C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL
Backend & AI: Go net/http, FastAPI, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, RAG, Ragas
Data & Infrastructure: Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Vector Databases, Docker, GitHub Actions, Prometheus
Concepts: Distributed Systems, Concurrency, Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS, API Security
Projects
Distributed Rate Limiting Middleware github.com/shivam-vishwakarmaa/Distributed-Rate-Limiting-Middleware
Go, Redis, Lua, Docker, Prometheus, k6, GitHub Actions
– Atomic algorithms under concurrency: Built a Go reverse proxy implementing 4 rate-limiting algorithms (fixed window,
sliding window log, token bucket, leaky bucket) as atomic Redis Lua scripts, removing read-modify-write races; 1,000
concurrent goroutines against a single key admit the exact configured limit, never more.
– Throughput: Sustained 5,000+ req/s at p50 <1ms and p99 <2.6ms under k6 load, with a measured single-instance
ceiling near 10,000 req/s.
– Failover: Added a per-algorithm circuit breaker with single-probe half-open recovery over a bounded in-memory fallback;
killed Redis mid-load-test and served 531k requests from the fallback with no incorrect denials.
– Engineering: 94.8% test coverage across 151 unit and real-Redis integration tests, a 7-stage GitHub Actions pipeline, and a
non-root distroless image.
Production-Grade RAG System github.com/shivam-vishwakarmaa/Production-Grade-RAG-System
Python, FastAPI, Ragas, Pytest, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions
– Architecture: End-to-end retrieval-augmented generation service in FastAPI with 500-token semantic chunking, dense vector
retrieval, and per-stage latency telemetry.
– Evaluation: Scored 0.92 faithfulness, 0.89 context precision, 0.91 context recall on a 30-pair golden QA benchmark
using Ragas.
– Regression gating: Wired a 3-tier pytest suite (unit, integration, semantic) into CI to block pull requests that degrade
retrieval metrics by more than 5%.
ShivamPay – Digital Payment & Lending Platform github.com/shivam-vishwakarmaa/shivam-pay
MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, Razorpay API, JWT, Zod shivam-pay.vercel.app
– Atomic ledger: Built a transaction engine on MongoDB multi-document ACID sessions; concurrent debit/credit tests
showed no double-spends under parallel load.
– Lending module: Implemented compound-interest schedules and instant loan foreclosure, secured with PIN authorization
and Zod validation across 15+ endpoints.
Achievements
• Competitive Programming: Solved 650+ DSA problems on LeetCode with a peak contest rating of 1766; ranked 1807
of 45,000+ in Weekly Contest 518. Active on Codeforces.
• GenAI Hackathon 2026: 2nd Runner-Up for NoteVault AI, an offline OCR and local-LLM study assistant.
Leadership Experience
GedIT Coding Club Pune, India
DSA Coordinator
– Mentorship: Mentored 60+ junior students in data structures, algorithms, structured problem-solving, and contest strategy.
